# Exact categorical reuse with capped local factories

9 November 2026. This is a simpler continuation of KILLED_WALK_EXTENSION.md, not an alteration of the original reviewed theorem. It needs no additional killing coins. Analytic result only; no run, practical timing or novelty claim.

## 1. Algorithm and explicit parameters

Assume the same exact independent sample-oracle contract as PROOF.md. The actual stored X has law P, and Q is fixed independently of its realized value under that contract. The alphabet [d] is known. Given rational 0<eta<=1/2, set

    L=ceil(2/eta),
    K=ceil(2d(L-1)/eta),
    C=1+2d(L-1),
    D=K+L C+2,
    B=2D.

In every one-label factory of the original algorithm, count its source queries. Run the original counter walk until a boundary is hit OR K queries have been executed. If query K hits LOWER, return LOWER. Any upper hit or an interior state after K queries returns UPPER. Thus LOCAL TIMEOUT is treated like UPPER.

The outer algorithm is unchanged: run this capped factory on X with P upward/Q downward; on LOWER return X. Otherwise repeatedly propose J~Q and run the same capped factory with Q upward/P downward. Accept J on UPPER, including its local timeouts, and repeat on LOWER. The number of residual attempts is NOT capped.

This is not the invalid global operation of timing out the whole coupling and substituting an independent Q sample. Both common-mass factories and the residual rejection law are changed consistently.

## 2. Exact common mass survives the local cap

Let a_K(p,q) be the probability of reaching LOWER by query K before reaching UPPER, from counter 1. In every such path, downward moves exceed upward moves by one. If it has u upward moves and h holds, multiplication by the initial probability p makes its probability proportional to

    (pq)^(u+1) [1-(p+q)/2]^h.

All omitted factors depend only on the path, and the permitted path set (including its length<=K condition) is unchanged when p,q are exchanged. Therefore

    d_K(p,q):=p a_K(p,q)=q a_K(q,p).

This also holds when one probability is zero; both sides vanish. Set d_K(0,0)=0. Define d_i=d_K(p_i,q_i), r_i=p_i-d_i, s_i=q_i-d_i and R=sum r_i=sum s_i. The actual complete joint law is

    Pr(X=i,Y=j)=d_i 1{i=j}+r_i s_j/R.

Its new marginal is exactly Q. The selected old sample is not replaced in proving its first marginal. No probabilities are evaluated by t

# Exact categorical sample reuse

An exact sample-only coupling algorithm with controlled latency and near-optimal expected query scaling

9 November 2026

## Main conclusion

An actual stored categorical outcome can be updated to an exactly correct new marginal using only independent samples from the old and new distributions. The construction makes disagreement at most eta worse than a maximal coupling, uses O(d/eta) expected new samples, and has a distribution-uniform exponential query-count tail on the broader O(d/eta^2) scale.

Three complementary lower bounds explain the costs. A deterministic global call cap requires Omega(d/eta^2). Under an exponential-moment assumption, even a balanced binary instance requires a second moment of order at least eta^-3. A reduction to published tolerant-testing results requires worst-case expected calls Omega(d/[eta log d]+sqrt(d)/eta), up to the one supplied input sample. Thus the expected query order is within a logarithmic factor in alphabet size of optimal under this information contract.

The proofs have received independent analytic review. This is a mathematical research package, not an implemented sampler, a measured speedup, or a claim of historical novelty. The small-alphabet cost example below is deliberately included because the asymptotic result alone does not establish practical value.

## Information contract

- P and Q are fixed unknown distributions on an explicitly encoded, known finite alphabet [d].
- The supplied input is the actual X~P that the operation is intended to retain. It is not replaced by a conveniently generated pair.
- Each new call returns an independent exact draw from its named source, independent of X and the operation's fresh fair bits.
- The algorithm has equality tests on labels, exact integer arithmetic and fair bits. It does not receive probabilities, density ratios, a shared source seed or distribution-dependent advice.
- Conditional applications are valid only when, conditional on the declared history, these same assumptions hold. The new target cannot be chosen arbitrarily after inspecting X.
- The guarantee is Y~Q marginally. It does not say that Y is an independent Q draw conditional on X.

The old sample is supplied free in the query count. Actual source runtime and the cost of obtaining this initial sample must be included when appropriate to the application.
